authorization: User explicitly requested all experiments addressing the professor's second feedback on2026-10-22. Existing completed PCA7/PCA9 and their frozen inputs remain read-only.

calibration.base: Exact immutable160-tree depth3 XGB risk teacher scores from completed PCA7; no XGB retraining is needed to isolate post-hoc calibration. Stronger independently validation-tuned200-tree XGB reference is retained separately, not mislabeled as the same teacher.
calibration.fit: Fit sigmoid and isotonic calibrators exclusively to training5OOF probabilities and labels. Apply the single resulting map to validation/test full-training teacher scores. Do not describe calibrated training predictions as cross-fitted, and do not inject calibrated training scores into a newly trained SVM.
calibration.sigmoid: Unweighted sklearn LogisticRegression(penalty=None,solver=lbfgs,max_iter=3000,tol=1e-10) on scalar raw probabilities; record slope and convergence, no validation/test fitting.
calibration.isotonic: sklearn IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds=clip), fitted on trainingOOF only.
calibration.tie_rules: validation_cost uses original probability-reference nearest1/6 among validation minimum-cost candidate cuts. rank_stable uses the highest score cut among equal minimum validation costs, invariant to strictly increasing transformations. Never choose a tie or calibration variant from test outcomes.

random_control.features: Independent Uniform(0,1) scalar for each original row and each of3 fixed draws. Deterministic SeedSequence(dataset_index,outer_seed,draw,part,20261022). No label or teacher score used to generate it.
random_control.architecture: Same PCA7 backbone and independent auxiliary Ry qubit as actual Rank Append;8qubits QSVC or8coordinates RBF. No extra entanglement. Both learners use the same random scalar per row/draw.
random_control.tuned: Same positive20lambda x3geometry x3C validation-only search as parent. HMEQ/Taiwan512-landmark proxy search followed by full-training exact SVC and its own validation-cost threshold.
random_control.matched: Reuse only the actual parent's validation-selected lambda/C/geometry, replace risk by independent random scalar, fit a fresh full-training exact SVC and choose its own validation threshold.
random_control.aggregation: Average3 random-draw costs within each outer seed before inference. n remains10, never30. Retain every draw, including unfavorable ones.

matched_backbone.tasks: For both actual methods, datasetsHMEQ/Taiwan and both kernels, refit risk-free lambda0 with C/geometry fixed to the parent's actual risk-selected values, and use its own validation threshold. Actual risk model remains the immutable parent model.
matched_backbone.purpose: Associate within-seed centered-label alignment/effective-rank changes with matched-backbone cost reduction, both full test and same256-test-row subset. Descriptive Spearman rho only, no independence-based correlation p-values or causal mechanism claims.
